title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 22
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 22: the bloody city and her abominations, the house of Israel as dross in the furnace, and the man who was sought in the gap.

questions.text: Which city was the prophet told to judge?
questions.explanation: Yahweh asks whether he will judge the bloody city, and tells him to cause her to know all her abominations.

questions.text: What has Yahweh made her to the nations?
questions.explanation: Because of the blood she has shed and the idols she has made, Yahweh has made her a reproach to the nations and a mocking to all the countries.

questions.text: What have the princes of Israel done in her?
questions.explanation: The princes of Israel, everyone according to his power, have been in her to shed blood.

answers.text: Built up the wall of the city
Shed blood, each according to his power
Judged the poor and needy rightly

questions.text: Whom have they wronged in her, according to verse 7?
questions.explanation: In her they have treated father and mother with contempt, oppressed the foreigner, and wronged the fatherless and the widow.

questions.text: What have they despised and profaned?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, 'You have despised my holy things, and have profaned my Sabbaths.'

answers.text: His holy things and his Sabbaths

questions.text: What have they taken in her in order to shed blood?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says that in her they have taken bribes to shed blood, and have taken interest and increase.

questions.text: What has the house of Israel become to Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says the house of Israel has become dross to him; they are the dross of silver in the middle of the furnace.

questions.text: What will Yahweh do after gathering them into the middle of Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: As silver and other metals are gathered into a furnace to be melted, so Yahweh will gather them in his wrath and melt them.

answers.text: Lead them out into the wilderness
Melt them with the fire of his wrath

questions.text: What are her princes compared to in verse 27?
questions.explanation: Her princes within her are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood and destroy souls, that they may get dishonest gain.

questions.text: What did Yahweh find when he sought a man to stand in the gap?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he sought for a man who would build up the wall and stand in the gap before him for the land, but he found no one.
